factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review reports operating profit €5,651k (2025) vs €8,061k (2024) with margins 2.7% vs 3.6%.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA declined to €8.3 million from €11.0 million, while the EBITDA margin fell to 4.0% from 4.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review shows EBITDA €8,250k (2025) vs €11,025k (2024) with margins 4.0% vs 4.9%.

factual_claims.claim: Administrative expenses decreased by approximately 14% to €6.8 million, primarily because weaker financial performance resulted in lower performance-based pay, but this reduction did not offset the decline in gross profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 11 shows administrative expenses €6,814k (2025) vs €7,878k (2024) - approx. 14% decrease. Financial review attributes this to lower staff costs from weaker performance.

factual_claims.claim: Net profit fell to €2.5 million from €5.2 million, and profit attributable to Nordecon’s owners decreased to €1.4 million from €3.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review states net profit €2,545k (2025) vs €5,165k (2024). Profit attributable to owners €1,439k vs €3,827k.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share declined to €0.05 from €0.12.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 7 shows basic and diluted EPS of €0.05 for 2025 vs €0.12 for 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Finance costs increased to €3.5 million from €3.0 million, mainly because the weakening of the Ukrainian hryvnia against the euro generated a €750 thousand foreign-exchange loss, compared with €258 thousand in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 reports finance costs €3,464k (2025) vs €3,011k (2024). Foreign exchange loss of €750k in 2025 vs €258k in 2024 is explicitly stated.

factual_claims.claim: In the fourth quarter, revenue rose to €60.6 million from €45.2 million, but gross margin fell to 5.9% from 9.0%, and the group recorded a €43 thousand net loss compared with a €618 thousand profit in the prior-year quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income shows Q4 2025 revenue €60,615k vs Q4 2024 €45,203k. Gross profit €3,616k (5.9%) vs €4,003k (9.0%). Profit for period was (€43k) vs €618k.

factual_claims.claim: The construction market in Estonia stabilised during the second half of the year, although economic growth was modest at an estimated 1%, construction prices rose 1.5%, and competition remained intense.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key figures and Operations in Estonia sections state market stabilization in H2, 1% economic growth, 1.5% construction price index rise, and intense competition.

factual_claims.claim: Nordecon secured €235.0 million of new contracts, compared with €181.4 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section reports new contracts €234,994k in 2025 vs €181,437k in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Its order book reached €273.1 million at year-end, up 30%, with approximately 69% of the backlog scheduled for 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book table shows €273,060k at 31 Dec 2025 (30% increase). Directors' report states approx. 69% scheduled for 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Infrastructure’s share rose to 42% from 18%, driven largely by major Rail Baltica and road contracts, while the Buildings backlog declined 7%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book breakdown shows Infrastructure 42% vs 18% in 2024. Buildings backlog decreased by 7% year-on-year.

factual_claims.claim: Management expects business volumes to increase in 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section states management expects business volumes to increase in 2026 based on order book size and market outlook.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash inflow was €1.2 million, while year-end cash declined to €5.3 million from €8.2 million, partly reflecting €2.9 million placed in long-term deposits.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows operating activities net cash inflow €1,204k. Cash and cash equivalents decreased from €8,195k to €5,266k. Investing activities include €2,898k placed in long-term deposits.

factual_claims.claim: Liquidity remained tight, with a current ratio of 0.93, and management identified liquidity exposure as higher than usual.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position shows current ratio 0.93 at 31 Dec 2025. Description of main risks section states liquidity exposure is higher than usual.

factual_claims.claim: No dividends were paid in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows dividends paid of €0 in 2025. Shareholders section confirms no dividends were paid.
